d: As a key and senior representative of LST or Lending Solutions Team, the role is to bridge the differences between the internal risk requirements versus client needs. And in order to do so effectively, the candidate must be able to think outside-the-box for solutions, that are balanced, whilst always keeping in view of the key priorities.

In this role as the Head of LST in GSAC and AMEE, the person will need to lead the teams in providing lending solutions in the Private Banking, across all the key footprint markets of Standard Chartered Bank for the AMEE and GSAC segment. In essence, to proactively propose bespoke financing solutions in meeting the requirements of our Private Banking clients, including helping to diversify and build their personal wealth, whilst driving the business by building localised lending products.

On the other hand, keeping an analytical view and assessment on the underlying risks whilst proposing mitigations to address such risks and upholding the values of Standard Chartered Bank. This role would also entail rolling-out new lending initiatives and lending programs to enhance our franchise and competitiveness globally.
q: Ability to articulate ideas confidently and concisely
To constantly challenge oneself to push beyond the current set of norms and to come out with creative solutions.
To be the difference – in converting a potential opportunity into fruition.
To drive the growth and strategy of LST in GSAC and AMEE.
At least 10-15 years of relevant lending experience and having a track record of leading a team.

Proficiency in credit analysis and a solid understanding of credit risk management principles, including concentration risk, covenant structuring, risk mitigation techniques, collateral management and etc.
Degree in Banking & Finance, Commerce, Economics, Business or related disciplines.
Proficiency in English and preferably Arabic speaking.

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
r: As a leader and representative of LST in the specified region, that person will be responsible for implementing the key lending strategies and businesses of the group and to roll-out localised lending initiatives to drive the business. As the manager of the team in that specified region, to ensure the development of the team both at individual and overall levels.

To lead and support lending strategy for the PvB locally, regionally and globally. This would mean not only rolling out new lending initiatives and programs but also to suggest and drive improvements to our current process and setup.

Actively originating lending deals by providing client-centric lending solutions to the Private Banking, GSAC and AMEE clients, including onshore India. As the first line of defence, to ensure sufficient risk management.
To enhance the understanding of lending by actively engaging with RMs and clients and market our lending products.
Contribute to the team and overall PvB budget by actively closing new lending deals expeditiously.

To lead the analysis and assessment of bespoke financing trades with a balanced risk vs reward view. This would include analysing and evaluation of the underlying company from both a fundamental and technical level, transaction structure as well as trade economics.
Actively engage senior stakeholders (both Business in Risk) on transactions and origination efforts.
Achieve team and individual financial targets as assigned.
Track market and general financial and economic developments
Proactively identify and spear head initiatives / projects to enhance PvB lending product offering / platform
Formulate strategy to grow the lending business for GSAC/AMEE region, including onshore India.
Collaborate with frontline, other support functions, business partners, and product specialists to deliver One Bank and provide effective client solutions.
Support the delivery of the Private Bank business’ short and longer-term objectives.
Ensure timely turnaround in tasks including enquiries from RMs and clients, ongoing reviews of existing accounts
Support the team in annual renewal cases / reviews, by providing guidance and comments.
Meet clients and tailor lending solutions based on clients’ needs and bank’s risk appetite and driving the approval for the proposed lending solutions.
Team leadership: Set direction for the team, role‑modelling inclusive leadership and high standards of client focus, risk discipline and collaboration.
Performance and conduct: Set clear expectations, remove obstacles to delivery, provide regular and constructive feedback, and reinforce expected conduct and standards.
Coaching and development: Uplift the capability of the team by developing the skills, judgement, and experience required to perform effectively and progress in their careers over time.

Thought Leadership and Market Positioning: Share sector, thematic and market insights with clients to strengthen strategic engagement and reinforce the Bank's market position. Partner with Industry, Product and Advisory teams to develop thought leadership content and client engagement initiatives.

Timeless Group of Companies is a family-owned retail, distribution, trading, and investment group based in Dubai, founded in 2003. Its aim is to empower and elevate established and emerging brands in the retail world through distribution and strategic brand-building services. The group’s vision is to become a go-to partner for retail and distribution solutions, known for excellence, integrity, and fostering a community of thriving brands. Through subsidiaries including Times Square Group and J.S.K Trading Limited, Timeless holds exclusive distribution, procurement, and master-franchise rights for premium and luxury international fashion, sports, and lifestyle brands across the Middle East and adjacent regions. Its work spans retail, distribution, trading, investments, and real estate, connecting international brands with regional markets. The company’s values include People, Honesty, Creativity, Transparency, Operations, and Leadership. Timeless describes diversity as a strength, with a team of cultures and talents that supports creativity and innovation. Its workforce approach emphasizes inclusion, cultural diversity, mentorship, and equitable opportunity.

As a Senior Marketing Executive, you will lead integrated marketing campaigns and regional brand strategy for a retail and distribution group working with premium and luxury international fashion, sports, and lifestyle brands. You will plan sports partnership activations, manage digital marketing channels, and coordinate events and sponsorships that strengthen brand presence across regional markets. The role combines 360-degree marketing with content planning, audience and market insight, and campaign analytics. You will oversee content production schedules and collaborate with regional stakeholders to align marketing activity with brand objectives and local market needs. This full-time, on-site position is based in the United Arab Emirates, with work connected to the group’s Dubai operations. You will bring senior-level experience, a marketing education, and the ability to connect brand strategy with effective execution across digital, social, content, and live experiences.
q: Demonstrated capability in 360-degree marketing and integrated marketing campaigns, with the ability to connect strategy, channel plans, and execution into cohesive brand activity.
Sports marketing expertise, including planning partnership activations and coordinating sponsorship activity that supports brand objectives and audience engagement.
Brand strategy and regional marketing skills, including the ability to adapt brand direction to relevant markets while maintaining consistent positioning.
Digital marketing and social media marketing experience, with sound judgment in managing channels and aligning activity with broader campaign plans.
Content marketing skills, including overseeing production schedules and coordinating content requirements to support campaigns across channels.
Event marketing experience, with the ability to coordinate events and sponsorships and keep relevant participants aligned on delivery.
Market research and campaign analytics capability, including analyzing performance metrics and using findings to inform marketing decisions.
Stakeholder management skills, including collaboration with regional stakeholders and clear communication across campaign planning and execution.
Experience working with retail, retail apparel and fashion, sporting goods, or sports, leisure, and recreation organizations is advantageous.
Exposure to premium or luxury international fashion, sports, or lifestyle brands and regional market expansion would be useful.
Experience coordinating sports partnerships and sponsorship activations across regional markets is an advantage.
A Bachelor of Business Administration with a specialization or field of study in Marketing, supporting a strong foundation for brand and campaign work.
Seven to ten years of relevant experience in marketing, including senior-level ownership of integrated or 360-degree campaigns.
Fluent English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with regional stakeholders.
A practical, organized approach to managing overlapping campaign, content, digital, event, and sponsorship priorities in an on-site, full-time role.
r: Lead integrated, 360-degree marketing campaigns across relevant channels, aligning campaign plans with brand objectives and regional market needs. Coordinate execution and maintain visibility of key deliverables.

Develop regional brand strategies for premium and luxury international fashion, sports, and lifestyle brands. Translate strategic direction into marketing plans suited to regional audiences and business priorities.
Plan sports partnership activations and coordinate sponsorship activity, ensuring the agreed marketing elements are organized and delivered in support of brand presence and engagement.
Manage digital marketing channels, including social media activity, and oversee content production schedules. Coordinate content requirements and timelines across the campaign calendar.
Coordinate marketing events and sponsorships, bringing together relevant internal and external stakeholders. Support consistent brand representation across activations and live experiences.
Analyze campaign performance metrics and market research to assess results and inform future marketing decisions. Share findings with stakeholders to guide improvements.
Collaborate with regional stakeholders to align campaign plans, channel activity, and brand priorities. Maintain clear communication throughout planning and execution.

d: Saudi German Health is hiring - Senior Network Security Engineer - Jeddah
We are looking for an experienced Senior Network Security Engineer to join our team and support the security of our enterprise network, endpoints, remote access, and applications.
The ideal candidate will bring strong hands-on experience across network and endpoint security, with particular expertise in Palo Alto, Cisco ISE/NAC, EDR, WAF, and ZTNA technologies.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
10 years of experience in IT Security.
Strong hands-on experience with Palo Alto firewalls and Cisco ISE .
Experience with EDR, WAF, NAC, ZTNA, and endpoint security/hardening .
Strong understanding of enterprise network security and threat detection.
Strong troubleshooting, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred certifications: CCNP Security, Microsoft Security certifications, or relevant GIAC certifications.
r: Manage and maintain Palo Alto firewalls , security policies, and access controls.
Manage Cisco ISE / Network Access Control (NAC) , including authentication, profiling, posture assessment, and 802.1X policies.
Implement and manage secure remote access through Prisma and Citrix ZTNA .
Configure and manage Web Application Firewall (WAF) solutions and security policies.
Administer Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) platforms for threat detection, malware prevention, and containment.
Monitor and investigate security alerts and coordinate remediation activities.
Implement endpoint hardening and security policies across Windows, Linux, and macOS environments.
Collaborate with SOC, Threat Intelligence, Network, and Infrastructure teams on security incidents and improvements.
Support compliance with security standards including NCA, ISO 27001, and CIS .

d: Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

The Store Manager oversees consistent operational excellence and holds full P&L responsibility, ensuring adherence to Brand compliance. This role fosters an environment aligned with Brand values, teamwork, result delivery, and exceptional customer service. The Store Manager is vital in planning, strategizing, and ensuring efficient store operations and financial outcomes, alongside developing staff capabilities and enhancing customer service to achieve business success.

What Qualifies You For The Role

Proficient in critical thinking, problem solving, and communication.

At Al-Futtaim Retail, we are part of a 90-year legacy built on ambition, progress and long-term vision. As one of the region’s leading retail operators, we partner with some of the world’s most trusted brands – including IKEA, ACE, Marks & Spencer and the Inditex Group – bringing global excellence to customers across MENA and Southeast Asia.

We don’t just operate stores; we shape retail experiences. From launching brands like Watsons and Kiabi to our regions for the first time, to investing in digital innovation, AI capabilities, the customer experience and loyalty platforms, we are constantly redefining the future of retail.

With over 100 nationalities spread across more than 10 countries, our strength lies in our diverse and collaborative community. Here, you’re equipped to turn your ambition into action, building the career you want, while helping us move retail forwards.
Join us and be part of The Heart of Tomorrow.
